column1: # Selection of Wikidata entities needed by wiktparse (wiktneeded, splitWikiDataResult).
# Format: group <TAB> id <TAB> comment; lines starting with # are comments.
# Groups and how they are used (P31 = instance of, P279 = subclass of):
#   languageCodeProps      entity has a claim with this property -> language
#   languageClasses        P31 (or P279: language types) -> language
#   languageMetaclasses    P31 -> language type (official language, dialect...)
#   lexicalClasses         P31 or P279 -> part of speech / lexical class
#   lexicalSuperclasses    P279 only (their instances are concrete words)
#   lexicalItems           these entities -> lexical (Wiktionary section concepts)
#   grammaticalClasses     P31 -> grammatical category or its value
#   linguisticsClasses     P31 or P279 -> linguistics term
#   writingSystemClasses   P31 or P279 -> writing system
#   termExcludedClasses    P31 -> not needed when found only by a header term label
#   termExcludedProps      claim present -> not needed when found only by a label (places)
